description: Free. Cross-check a seller's signed x402 offer + receipt (offer-and-receipt extension): verifies the signatures (official x402 functions; pin the seller with sellerAddress for EIP-712 or sellerJwk for JWS), checks offer and receipt agree, and returns the exact `claim` to prove with verify_payment. Pass that verification's checkId to learn which side failed.
name: check_x402_receipt
